title: HOW NIX FINALLY ENDED THE SCOOTER WAR! 🛴

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: BRUNO, STOP RUNNING AND LOOK AT THIS RECEIPT BEFORE YOU REGRET EVERYTHING YOU HAVE DONE TO ME!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: I told you I don't have your stupid money [beat] so just take the broken scooter and leave me alone before things get ugly!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I didn't come here to take anything back from you [beat] I actually went to the repair shop this morning and paid off your entire outstanding balance.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Wait, you actually paid for the engine I trashed last summer [beat] why would you ever do something that insane for someone who hates you?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Because watching you look over your shoulder every single day [beat] was starting to make even my own life feel like a heavy prison of grudges.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: I heard everything from the hallway [beat] and I must say I have never seen a student resolve a massive debt with such grace and maturity.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: I have spent months making your life a total nightmare [beat] and now you are the only reason the shop owner isn't calling my parents tonight.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I don't want a fake apology or a public thank you [beat] I just want this cycle of trashing each other's property to finally end right here.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Consider the debt settled forever [beat] and if anyone else tries to mess with your new ride, they will have to deal with me first.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nix realized that sometimes the best way to destroy an enemy [beat] is to simply turn them into someone who truly owes you a life-changing favor.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Everyone in the school hallway was staring at us [beat] but for the first time in years, the tension felt like it finally evaporated into thin air.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that is how Nix proved [beat] that in this world, kindness is the only currency that actually buys you a completely clean slate.
